build_bow_ranker_model: build a bag of words ranking model using ExampleBagOfWordsModel with an embedding encoder
encode_text_vectors: encode text vectors into embeddings using the ExampleBagOfWordsModel encode_text method
score_candidates: score candidate response vectors against context using the TraAgent score_candidates method
add_cmdline_args: add command line arguments for the bag of words model including hidden-dim to a parser
review_TraAgent: review the TraAgent class which extends TorchRankerAgent with a bag of words ranking model
